speaker: Doctor
text: I need to ask you a few questions to understand your symptoms better. Since you are an 8-month-old boy, can you tell me when you first noticed feeding difficulties and if you seem to have trouble passing stool?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: That tenderness is a significant finding. Has there been any blood mixed with the stool, or has he been vomiting anything green (bilious)? REQUEST TEST: Stool_Occult_Blood, Urinalysis. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the baby been passing gas or stool at all during this time, and are his lower limbs and external genitalia moving and developing normally? DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease
